{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes CMakeLists.txt and cmake/bitcoin-build-config.h.in to configure and validate CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR and CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBEXECDIR.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes an installation directory lookup bug on distributions such as Arch Linux that configure non-default libexec paths. Direct binary execution is unaffected, but installed packages on these distributions currently fail to locate internal binaries."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Directly updates src/bitcoin.cpp and its build glue, which is the process-spawning wrapper explicitly covered under IPC.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Resolves an execvp failure where the bitcoin wrapper cannot launch bitcoin-node or bitcoind when installed in distro layouts with custom libexec dirs. Spawning is completely broken on affected installations."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/bitcoin.cpp and adds test/functional/tool_bitcoin.py to fix and test the bitcoin wrapper tool.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Corrects path resolution in the bitcoin wrapper CLI tool, preventing immediate failure when invoking sub-executables on systems setting CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBEXECDIR to 'lib'."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,
    "bug_severity": 2,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 0
  }
}
